Monaer brake products

Pads, discs and brake care from one brand, supplied from Skudai, Johor.

Check my car on WhatsApp

Brake pads

Nano ceramic pads for daily cars, premium models and EVs.

  • Nano ceramic friction material
  • Heat fade resistance from 600°C, 800°C on performance pads (as listed by Monaer)
  • Low dust, so rims stay cleaner
  • Quieter braking and longer disc life

Brake discs

High-carbon discs with a silver anti-rust coating.

  • High-carbon disc material
  • Silver protective coating that helps stop rust and corrosion in wet weather
  • Drilled and slotted design
  • One box holds the left and right pair

Brake fluid and brake care

DOT 4 and DOT 5.1 brake fluid, cleaner spray, grease and gloves.

  • Monaer brake fluid in DOT 4 and DOT 5.1
  • Monaer brake parts cleaner spray
  • High-temperature anti-noise grease
  • Monaer work gloves

Product details on this site are as published by Monaer Brake System Malaysia. Ask us for the details of your exact part.

How to get Monaer pads for your car

  1. 1

    Send your car details

    Make, model, year and engine on WhatsApp. A photo of your road tax or the old pad helps.

  2. 2

    We match the part

    We check the Monaer catalogue number against your car's original part number.

  3. 3

    Fit at a workshop

    Collect from us in Skudai or have it fitted at a Monaer workshop near you.
